{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Subset to LOYAL customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Verify LOYAL customers exist
assert not df_loyal.empty, 'No LOYAL customers found in the data'

# Compute number of LOYAL customers and number who converted
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)
n_converted_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate_loyal = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print all required values to ensure they are traceable
print(f'Number of LOYAL customers: {n_loyal}')
print(f'Number of LOYAL customers who converted: {n_converted_loyal}')
print(f'Conversion rate among LOYAL customers: {conversion_rate_loyal}')"}
